draft.subject: Re: your intake hire
draft.body:
Hi Dana,

Saw Brightwell Law is hiring an intake coordinator to run new-client calls and conflict checks. That usually means client details being typed into more than one system.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is keeping that intake work private on your radar?

claims.text: Brightwell Law is hiring an intake coordinator to run new-client calls and conflict checks
We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Intake Coordinator (full time). You will be the first point of contact for new clients, running intake calls, conflict checks and new-matter forms.
Our 14 attorneys advise on estate planning, probate and residential real estate.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
